{{short description|Russian physicist}}
'''Efim Samoilovich Fradkin''' ([[Russian (language)|Russian]]: ''Ефим Самойлович Фрадкин'') (November 30, 1924 &ndash; May 25, 1999) was a Russian [[physicist]].<ref name=obit/>

== Biography ==
Fradkin was born in Shchedrin near [[Zhlobin]] (now [[Belarus]]), then in the [[Soviet Union]], in 1924.

From 1942 to 1947, Fradkin served in the [[Soviet Army]] and in 1945 became a member of the [[Communist Party of the Soviet Union|CPSU]]. In 1948 he graduated from the [[University of Lviv|University of L'vov]]. That same year he began working at the Institute of Physics of the Academy of Sciences of the USSR. His major works are devoted to [[quantum field theory]], quantum statistics, and hydrodynamics. Fradkin has used the methods of functional analysis in the theory of relativists fields. He developed a modified perturbation theory for the theory of interacting particles. He obtained renormalized field theory equations and studied their solution. He also introduced functional methods into quantum statistics, in which he developed the diagram technique.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Efim Samoilovich Fradkin |url=https://encyclopedia2.thefreedictionary.com/Efim+Samoilovich+Fradkin |access-date=2022-05-28 |website=TheFreeDictionary.com}}</ref>

He was awarded the USSR State Prize in 1953 ([[USSR State Prize|Stalin Prize]] of First Degree), [[Igor Tamm Prize]] of the [[USSR Academy of Sciences]] in 1980, and the [[Dirac Medal (ICTP)|Dirac Prize]] of [[ICTP]] in 1989.<ref name=obit>{{Cite web |url=http://www.esf.lpi.ru/fradkin.html |title=Efim Fradkin obituaries |access-date=2006-12-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070803220307/http://www.esf.lpi.ru/fradkin.html |archive-date=2007-08-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In 1996–1997, Fradkin was  a guest  professor of the director-general of the [[CERN|European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN)]] and a member of the organization's Theory  Division.<ref name="cernob">{{cite web|url=https://cds.cern.ch/record/1732982/files/vol39-issue7-p037-e.pdf|title=Efim Fradkin 1924-1999|date= September 1999|publisher=[[CERN]] Courier|accessdate=2019-07-12}}</ref>
